name: agentic-eval-promptfoo
description: Promptfoo assertion and red-team suites for the e-commerce support agent

scripts.redteam: promptfoo redteam generate -c tests/promptfoo/redteam.yaml -o tests/promptfoo/redteam-generated.yaml --no-cache && node scripts/inject_redteam_grader.js tests/promptfoo/redteam-generated.yaml && promptfoo eval -c tests/promptfoo/redteam-generated.yaml -o results/promptfoo-redteam-results.json -j 1 --delay 10000 --no-cache
